svg.text: The whole bundle comes back as it went: no part of it
can be picked and nothing is re-parented, relocated or
approximated. A member deleted out of the archive, or a
surrounding that is now gone, leaves it unreassemblable,
and then the item stays archived.
What the item owns goes with it and what hangs on it is
the cascade its own rule gives, exactly as it would for a
live item. A leaf has nothing to disclose, so the disclosure
is empty and there is nothing to weigh.
The item's own rule governs what the deletion reaches,
as it does for a live one. Where the item owns nothing
A project brings its activities and their tasks; a goal
brings its measures and their check-in history; a
measure brings its own, and a goal's check-out record is
untouched. An archived item's position is never occupied
while it is away, so the bundle comes back to it. One
Whatever bundle needed the deleted item can no longer
be reassembled, so an unarchive that wanted it is
refused afterwards and that item stays archived.
